[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Books Exchange (hard version)** [CF 1249B2 · Books Exchange (hard version)](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/1249/B2){rating="1300"}

Kid $i$'s book travels $i \to p_i \to p_{p_i} \to \cdots$, so it returns after exactly the length of $i$'s cycle in $p$. Every kid on one cycle gets the same answer, so walk each cycle once, count its length, and write that length into all of its members: $O(n)$ in total.

[Solved in full in @sec-idx-p3-books.]{.card-link}
